entities.summary: Nearby Share was a functionality developed by Google that allowed data to be transferred between devices via Bluetooth, Wi-Fi Direct or Internet. In 2024, it was merged into Samsung's Quick Share. It was available for Android, ChromeOS and Microsoft's Windows. It was first released on August 4, 2020.
